info.prompt: Bio-digital ritual chamber, the charge meter a pulsating chandelier of skeletal gold and neon veins, its segments filling with viscous light—when Farkles hit, it recoils like a wounded beast, ejecting amber ichor into the void-black abyss, while the ultimate roll triggers a cascading wave of crystalline growth that engulfs the dice in faceted prisons, the neural lattice beneath the table flaring with cyan fire as the entire space distorts into a gothic mandala of synaptic connections and alchemical symbols.
